text:
Maya: Found the gold paperclip under the whiteboard bench. :eyes:
Ronen: Wait. That's the mythical clip. Thought it ascended during the Great Clip Migration.
Liz: Bring it to the kitchen table. This deserves a tiny ritual.
Maya: proposing rules: who refactors the most controversial file this week gets custody for a day. :scroll:
ops-bot: FYI: Please do not attach office keys to non-official artifacts. Policy 3.4.1 enforced. :rotating_light: 
Ronen: @Maya that's excessively ceremonial but i'm here for it. also my laundry is due.
Liz: poll: rename options — "Clip of Commitment" (:one:) vs "The Golden Binder" (:two:). React.
Maya: :one:
Ronen: :two: saddest emoji.
Liz: counting reactions silently. Also, @Sam (design) can we make a tiny plaque?
Sam (design): yes. laser-engraved metal or sticker? :art:
Maya: sticker is chaotic and adorable.
Ronen: metal. it's now legendary.
Liz: current tally: metal x2, sticker x1, chaotic vibe x1. coin flip time.
Maya: flipped. metal wins. Shoutout to @Tasha for noticing it (post-it breadcrumb trail).
Tasha: guilty. The clip smiled at me. :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: New artifact note: Artifacts must not be used as doorstops nor as keychains. -ops
Ronen: we need a plaque that says "Do Not Use As Staple".
Maya: filing backlog ticket artifact-1: "Golden Paperclip Plaque"
Liz: assigning to @Sam (design). Target: next all-hands.
Sam (design): acknowledged. will mock up a tiny ceremonial box too. :package:
Maya: capturing this in lore: "When the paperclip returns, so does the memecoin."
Liz: ritual draft:
```
Ceremony of the Golden Paperclip
1) Gather by the kitchen table
2) Recite: "I will not hoard office supplies"
3) Pass the clip clockwise
4) Take a group photo for the archive
```
Ronen: saved to #lore and my camera roll.
Tasha: honored to be the clip's temporary shepherd. :sheep:
Maya: i'll bring a tiny velvet pouch for the first handoff. Lunch ceremony at noon. :tea:
